summary: On an orange(7) background there are exactly two other colors: the MARKER color (least cells -- always a single 5-cell plus shape) and the BLOCK color (most cells -- solid squares of side 1..7). For each 4-connected block object, test whether its bbox has both dimensions odd (odd-sided square). If odd-sided blocks outnumber even-sided ones, the plus is KEPT; otherwise it is erased to the background. Either way, every odd-sided block's center cell is painted with the marker color.
